proposed_comments.title: Guard unsupported-file async callbacks against rebinding

confidence.rationale: Content-type, icon, and folder-size operations outlive cancellation in several paths; a reused previewer needs an item-generation check before every shared Preview or State mutation.

proposed_comments.body:
### Ignore asynchronous results from a previous unsupported-file binding

**Severity:** `high`

Rebinding an unsupported-file previewer clears the displayed metadata, but the previous item’s content-type, icon, folder-size, or exception completion can still arrive later and write into the same preview object. Track a binding generation (or equivalent item identity) and validate it before every asynchronous result, progress callback, and error-state update so rapid navigation cannot mix metadata between files. This should cover both successful completions and exceptions from non-cancelable awaits.
proposed_comments.reason: Held while the author prepares a broader tested update.
